summary: Pre-computes cumulative arc length over a 3D keyframe array. The array base pointer is read from this+0x0 and the keyframe count from this+0x4; keyframes use a 28-byte stride (7 floats: 3D position at elements 0..2, accumulated distance at element 6). The first keyframe has its element at +0x18 (accumulated distance) set to 0; each later keyframe writes element +0x18 as the 3D Euclidean distance from the previous keyframe added to the previous keyframe's accumulated value. After the loop this+0x8 is assigned from the array at byte offset 28*i-60 (i being the loop-exit count), and the keyframe array pointer is returned. Called by sub_457F90 (00457f90) and BufferAllocCopy (004582e0).

local_names.this: descriptor holding the keyframe array pointer (+0x0), keyframe count (+0x4) and the precomputed path-length result (+0x8)
local_names.base: keyframe array pointer read from this+0x0, 28-byte stride
local_names.accumulated: per-keyframe accumulated arc length stored at element +0x18

operations.description: Walks the keyframe array pointed to by this+0x0, once per keyframe for the count in this+0x4
First keyframe (index 0) takes the separate zero-initialization branch because it has no predecessor; later keyframes take the distance-accumulation branch
First keyframe's element at +0x18 (6th float of the 28-byte stride) is set to 0
For each later keyframe, computes the 3D deltas against the previous keyframe: differences of the x/y/z floats at the current element minus the preceding 28-byte stride
Writes the keyframe element at +0x18 as the 3D Euclidean distance (square root of the summed squared deltas) added to the previous keyframe's accumulated value at the same relative slot
After the loop, assigns this+0x8 from the keyframe array at byte offset 28*i-60 where i is the loop-exit count; the skeleton fill reads this as the total accumulated path length
Returns the keyframe array pointer read from this+0x0
Invoked by sub_457F90 (00457f90) and BufferAllocCopy (004582e0) to pre-compute cumulative keyframe distances
